'''DS-61-9''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[TIE pilot]] who served<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|212|DS-61-9}}</ref> by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] occurred,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> during which [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] attacked the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> DS-61-9 was among the Imperial [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who fought in the battle,<ref name="CSWE" /> where Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] attempted to defend the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] from the Alliance's starfighters. The Battle of Yavin ultimately ended in an Imperial defeat when the Alliance destroyed the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Black_Nine.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''A New Hope'' set of the ''Star Wars Trading Card Game'' used this image to represent DS-61-9, but another card within the game's ''Battle of Yavin'' set attaches an image of the same starfighter to represent DS-29-4.]]
The name DS-61-9 was coined by [[2002]]'s [[A New Hope (TCG)|''A New Hope'']] expansion set of the ''[[Star Wars Trading Card Game]]''. Although the card identified DS-61-9 as the designation of the starfighter,<ref name="TCG">{{TCG|set=A New Hope|cardname=TIE Fighter DS-61-9|link=https://swtcg.com/Content/Images/Cards/ANH/TIE_Fighter_DS_61_9.webp?v=2}}</ref> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' would later identify that name as the pilot's call sign.<ref name="CSWE" /> This article is written with the assumption that the latter source is correct.

The image used for DS-61-9's card is that<ref name="TCG" /> of a TIE/LN starfighter from the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> However, the card game's [[2003]] [[Battle of Yavin (TCG)|''Battle of Yavin'']] set also uses an image of the same starfighter to represent [[DS-29-4]]. That name was also coined as a starfighter designation,<ref name="TCG2">{{TCG|set=Battle of Yavin|cardname=TIE Fighter DS-29-4|link=https://swtcg.com/Content/Images/Cards/BOY/TIE_Fighter_DS_29_4.webp?v=2}}</ref> before ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' no differently treated DS-29-4 as a pilot call sign.<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|I|212|DS-29-4}}</ref> This article treats both DS-61-9 and DS-29-4 as separate TIE pilots and avoids linking either of the pilots to the fighter shown in ''A New Hope''.
